steps.title: PostgreSQL Approved Request Read-Back
steps.description: Confirm request is APPROVED and student standing is ON_LEAVE under RLS-forced tables
steps.query: SELECT r.id, r.status AS request_status, s.status AS standing FROM stu.lifecycle_requests r JOIN stu.lifecycle_status s ON s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE r.tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND r.id = '99999999-0004-0000-0000-000000000001' AND r.status = 'APPROVED' AND s.status = 'ON_LEAVE'

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Decide Blocked
steps.description: Unauthenticated POST decide contract returns HTTP 401 (approval workflow gated by gateway)
